language_review.status: pending review; do not treat all failures as false positives or as a blanket unsupported-language claim
language_review.selection_method: The check says it heuristically infers supported GF glyphsets, then tests the languages belonging to them. This differs from the separately documented CLDR exemplar coverage baseline.
language_review.matching_limit: Direct base-code comparison is not a complete language equivalence map. Macrolanguages, dialects and code aliases can relate additional GF entries to a CLDR locale (for example ff/Fulah and fuf/Pular).

concrete_failure_overlaps.finding: GF mandatory repertoire requires U+0329 COMBINING VERTICAL LINE BELOW, which is missing; GF also reports auxiliary sequences using this mark. Compare orthography variants against the CLDR exemplar baseline before defining support.
GF mandatory repertoire includes seven missing modifier letters: U+1D53, U+1D52, U+1D4B, U+2071, U+1D43, U+1DA4, U+1DB6. Review the GF and CLDR target definitions.

language_review.interpretation: Most flagged GF language identifiers are not direct entries in the 238-locale baseline. Nevertheless actual overlaps and different orthography requirements exist. Existing CLDR coverage evidence is narrower than full GF language-shaping compliance. All 12 shape_languages FAIL results remain unresolved.
